content: Always have key certifications (SGS, TÜV) printed or saved on a demo device for immediate display. Never say 'I'll email it later' when the customer asks to see it now.
When a customer mentions a competitor's certification, be ready with a side-by-side comparison on a tablet or printed sheet. Use the store environment to show the difference physically.

For customers with low decision power, create urgency by offering a time-limited store incentive (e.g., 'if you decide today, I can include a free case') to encourage immediate purchase or at least a faster follow-up.
Use live demos that directly address the customer's specific use case (e.g., anti-glare for window seating) to make the benefit tangible.
Prepare a 'certification binder' or digital folder on the store tablet containing PDFs of all relevant certificates, warranty terms, and test reports for instant access.

name: Live Certification Showcase
condition: When a customer asks for proof of certification or feature claims.
example: Keep PDFs of all certifications on a demo tablet. When asked, immediately open the PDF and highlight key test results, then demonstrate the feature (e.g., anti-glare tilt) to connect the certificate to real-world benefit.

name: Competitor Side-by-Side Demo
condition: When a customer mentions a competitor's feature or certification.
example: Have a competitor device (e.g., Xiaomi) available in-store. When customer says 'Xiaomi has TÜV', pull out both tablets, show the certification comparison on a screen, and then do a live demo (e.g., tilt both toward light) to visually prove the difference.

name: Joint Decision Follow-Up Kit
condition: When a customer says they need to consult a spouse or partner.
example: Prepare a physical or digital 'decision kit' with a comparison chart, key benefits summary, and a special offer valid for 24 hours. Hand it to the customer and say, 'This has everything you and your husband need to decide. If you come back today, I can include this free accessory.'

objection: Can you show me the actual SGS certificate?
rebuttal_template: Absolutely, I have it right here on my tablet. Let me open the PDF — you can see the SGS report number [report number] and the test results for low blue light, flicker-free, and anti-glare. And to show you the anti-glare in action, let me tilt the screen toward the light — see how clear it stays? That's the SGS difference.

objection: Xiaomi has TÜV Rheinland certification, what makes SGS better?
rebuttal_template: Great question. Let me show you a side-by-side comparison on this tablet. TÜV Rheinland tests only blue light ratio. SGS Eye Care tests three things: low blue light, flicker-free, and anti-glare. That anti-glare is critical if your child sits near a window. Watch — I'll tilt both tablets toward the light. You see the reflection on this Xiaomi? Now look at the MatePad Air — zero reflection. That's the SGS advantage you can see right now.

objection: I need to come back with my husband.
rebuttal_template: Of course, that's a smart decision. But before you go, let me show you one more thing that will help you both decide. I'll set up this demo with the anti-glare and battery test running side by side. And if you both come back today, I can offer a special in-store bundle — a free screen protector and a 10% discount on the keyboard. Let me write down the details for you to take home.
